pages.text: Akaishi gear is an upgraded Netherite set, approximately ×1.25 on stats:$(li)armor {4,7,10,4} (boots/legs/chest/head), toughness 4$(li)knockback resistance 0.1, enchantability 15$(li)the sword deals 11 damage; pickaxe, shovel and axe exceed Netherite by the same ratio$(br2)$(bold)The set is no longer crafted at a table;$(reset) it is produced at the Equipment Forger described below.

$(bold)Production:$(reset) every piece of Akaishi gear is produced by the $(l:akaishi:equipment_forger)Equipment Forger$(/l); Netherite gear and Akaishi Ingots are supplied, and each piece has its own cost.$(br2)$(bold)Enhancement:$(reset) after recasting, the $(l:akaishi:upgrade_station)Upgrade Station$(/l) adds special abilities, requiring the $(l:akaishi:upgrade_template)Upgrade Template$(/l).$(br2)For automated ingot production, see $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l).
The Forger, the Station and the Template form one pipeline: recast, then add abilities. Akaishi Ingots are the recasting fuel.
